enrichment_method.evidence: phosphopeptides were enriched with Fe3+-NTA magnetic beads (PureCube Fe-NTA MagBeads, Cube Biotech), washed three times with 80% ACN, 0.1% TFA and eluted in 50% ACN, 2.5% NH4OH.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: Peptides were resuspended in 4% ACN, 3% FA and analyzed on an Orbitrap Eclipse Mass Spectrometer (ThermoFisher Scientific) equipped with an Easy1200 nanoLC system (ThermoFisher Scientific).
